title: 8888 Citizens' Complaint Hotline
content: As of 2026-10-07, citizens text 8888 from Globe, Smart, and their affiliate telcos to file complaints. The service covers graft and corrupt practices by government officials and employees. It also covers slow and inefficient delivery of government services and requests for government assistance. The text service is free of charge. The 8888 Citizens' Complaint Center is one of the constituent offices of the OP Strategic Action and Response Office. The source page is dated 2020-11-25 and lists no hours or website, so check current channels with the Office of the President. Source: https://pco.gov.ph/PCO-content/on-text-8888/ (checked 2026-10-07).

title: Emergency hotline 911
content: As of 2026-10-07, 911 is the single number to call for emergencies. The Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) runs the unified 911 service. A DILG regional page posted on 2025-09-05 says the unified 911 line starts on 11 September. The service is free and available 24/7. It covers police, fire, medical, and disaster response. Source: https://calabarzon.dilg.gov.ph/one-number-for-all-emergencies-unified-911-to-launch-nationwide/ (checked 2026-10-07).

title: PSA certificates through PSAHelpline
content: As of 2026-10-07, the PSAHelpline hotline is (02) 8737-1111. Phone lines are open Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, except holidays. The email address is help@psahelpline.ph and it is available 24/7. PSAHelpline delivers PSA birth, marriage, and death certificates, CENOMAR, and CENODEATH to your home or office. Order online at psahelpline.ph. The PSA website is psa.gov.ph. Source: https://psahelpline.ph/ (checked 2026-10-07).

title: SSS hotline 1455
content: As of 2026-10-07, the SSS hotline is 1455. The official SSS website is www.sss.gov.ph. The SSS handles member contributions, benefits, and loans. The SSS website says regular payment of contributions is essential to qualify for benefits and loans. The page shows no separate contact center number. Source: https://www.sss.gov.ph/ (checked 2026-10-07).

title: BIR hotline and website
content: As of 2026-10-07, the BIR contact page lists the hotline (02) 8538-3200. The official BIR website is www.bir.gov.ph. BIR stands for Bureau of Internal Revenue. The website offers tax information, regulations, and eServices for taxpayers. The page lists no hours for the hotline. Source: https://www.bir.gov.ph/contactus (checked 2026-10-07).

title: NBI hotline and clearance contacts
content: As of 2026-10-07, the NBI main office hotline is (02) 8523-8231 for general inquiries. The NBI Clearance Center answers clearance questions at (02) 8524-1277 and 0939 150 2880. The center is on United Nations Avenue, Ermita, Manila, and opens Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Apply for an NBI clearance online at clearance.nbi.gov.ph. The NBI has divisions that address crimes such as fraud, public corruption, human trafficking, and cybercrime. Source: https://nbi.gov.ph/contact/ (checked 2026-10-07).
